title: Operator identities stay pseudonymous where they leave the clone: the KB-Operator trailer, publish and export guards
goal: the commit hook adds KB-Operator with the operator id to each commit made in an agent session, beside KB-Teams, and check-trailers accepts an id there and refuses an email address; kbgit.py publish refuses a commit whose message or trailers hold an email address other than a noreply or placeholder one; kbmon's OpenTelemetry export names the operator by kb.operator.id and drops an email-shaped resource attribute; the public home's handling of git author emails and an operator field in the query log follow the operator's answers
